title: The Best in East
description:
EAST NASHVILLE 2023 New construction home with 5 bedrooms , 4 baths and one of the bedrooms is on the 1st floor.  The house sleeps 12 people with 1 full bed,  2 king beds & 3 queen beds.

We provide comfortable beds with soft linens and plenty of blankets and pillows. Beautiful décor. Stocked kitchen. Free parking. Walking distance to amazing restaurants, bars and shopping.

Pets welcome for $200 

Walking distance to 5 points 
 2 miles from Broadway
1.5 miles from Titan's Nissan Stadium

The space
Bedroom 1 - King size bed and full bathroom  with double vanity and double shower heads. 
Bedroom 2- queen size bed. Shared full bath w/ tub
Bedroom 3-  king size bed .  Shared full bath w/ tub
Bedroom 4 - 1 queen & 1 full size beds ...  attached to full bathroom with double vanity. 
bedroom 5 -  Queen size bed on first floor.
Full bathroom on main level and additional full bathroom on 2nd floor. 4 total full bathrooms.

Other things to note
THIS IS NOT A PARTY HOUSE. There are only 12 people allowed in the house at all times pending our Metro short term rental code guidelines. 

**1203 Lillian Street is not an event space. No Weddings, Rehearsal dinners, Bachelor / Bachelorette parties, New Year’s Eve , etc. **

Please follow Metro codes noise ordinance rules:
Quiet Hours: Unreasonable and excessive noise that disturbs the peace (yelling, loud music, etc.) is prohibited, especially between 11:00 p.m. and 7:00 a.m.

If a noise complaint is received by a neighbor, it is grounds for eviction and loss of rent paid.

No SMOKING permitted in home.  $500 cleaning fee will be charged.
